 102 func add_icon(parent: Node, texture: Texture2D, dimension: int) -> void:
 103 	var icon := TextureRect.new()
 104 	icon.texture = texture
 105 	icon.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
 106 	icon.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
 107 	icon.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(dimension, dimension)
 108 	parent.add_child(icon)
 109 
 110 func add_bar(parent: Node, node_name: String) -> ProgressBar:
 111 	var bar := ProgressBar.new()
 112 	bar.name = node_name
 113 	bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 12)
 114 	bar.show_percentage = false
 115 	parent.add_child(bar)
 116 	return bar
 117 
 118 func ignore_mouse(node: Node) -> void:
 119 	if node is Control:
 120 		node.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
 121 	for child in node.get_children():
 122 		ignore_mouse(child)
 123 
 124 func refresh(snapshot: Dictionary) -> void:
 125 	var player: Dictionary = snapshot.get("player", {})
 126 	health.max_value = player.get("max_health", 100)
 127 	health.value = player.get("health", 0)
 128 	health_text.text = "生命  %d / %d" % [health.value, health.max_value]
 129 	energy.max_value = player.get("max_energy", 100)
 130 	energy.value = player.get("energy", 0)
 131 	energy_text.text = "飞牌能量  %d / %d" % [energy.value, energy.max_value]
 132 	room_name.text = snapshot.get("room_name", "")
 133 	objective.text = "目标：" + snapshot.get("objective", "")
 134 	moonstep.visible = snapshot.get("moonstep", false)
 135 	var status: String = snapshot.get("save_status", "none")
 136 	var statuses: Dictionary = {"none": "尚未在神龛存档", "saved": "已存入本浏览器" if OS.has_feature("web") else "进度已保存", "failed": "保存失败 · 本次仍可重试", "pending": "正在保存…", "unavailable": "浏览器存储不可用"}
 137 	save_label.text = statuses.get(status, "")
 138 	save_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 0.55, 0.55) if status in ["failed", "unavailable"] else Color(0.77, 0.72, 0.85))
 139 	notice.text = snapshot.get("notice", "")
 140 	notice_panel.visible = not notice.text.is_empty()
 141 	boss_panel.visible = false
 142 	for boss in snapshot.get("bosses", []):
 143 		if not boss.get("dead", false) and boss.get("arena_active", false):
 144 			boss_panel.visible = true
 145 			boss_bar.max_value = boss.max_health
 146 			boss_bar.value = boss.health
 147 			boss_text.text = "皇家庄家 · 第%d阶段   %d / %d" % [boss.phase, boss.health, boss.max_health]
 148 			break
 149 	_layout_status_panels.call_deferred()
 150 
 151 func _layout_status_panels() -> void:
 152 	# Container heights can grow with Moonstep/objective wrapping. Keep the status
 153 	# panels below that real height and clear of the grounded melee lane.
 154 	var next_y: float = $Top.get_rect().end.y + 10.0
 155 	notice_panel.offset_top = next_y
 156 	notice_panel.offset_bottom = next_y + notice_panel.get_combined_minimum_size().y
 157 	if notice_panel.visible:
 158 		next_y = notice_panel.offset_bottom + 8.0
 159 	boss_panel.offset_top = next_y
 160 	boss_panel.offset_bottom = next_y + boss_panel.get_combined_minimum_size().y
